content.title: Is the stock market open on Good Friday? Holiday schedules
content.text: April 2, 2026, 9:53 a.m. ETGood Friday is observed by Christians to commemorate the crucifixion of Jesus Christ.The New York Stock Exchange and Nasdaq will be closed on Good Friday.The U.S. bond market will be open on Good Friday but will close early at 12 p.m. EDT.On Friday, April 3, Christians around the world observe Good Friday to commemorate the crucifixion of Jesus Christ, part of Holy Week that leads up to Easter Sunday. The day is observed with mourning, reflection, and special church services.Good Friday is not a federal holiday in the United States, but it is a state public holiday in Florida, and state offices and local courts may be closed. Some businesses and services may also be closed or have limited hours. Most banks will be open for regular business hours. Mail will be delivered as usual, as will UPS and FedEx services.Will stock markets be open?Is the stock market open on Good Friday?The New York Stock Exchange will be closed on Friday, April 3, and will reopen for trading at normal hours, 9:30 a.m. ET to 4 p.m., on Monday, April 6.NYSE American Equities, NYSE Arca Equities, NYSE National, and NYSE Texas late trading sessions also will be closed.After Friday, the stock market schedule will be business as usual until the markets close again on Monday, May 25, for Memorial Day.Is Nasdaq open on Good Friday?Nasdaq will be closed on Friday and will reopen at normal trading hours on Monday.Is the U.S. bond market open on Friday, April 3, 2026?The U.S. bond market will be open on Good Friday but will close early, at 12 p.m. EDT, according to the Securities Industry and Financial Markets Association. The bond market will reopen at normal hours on Tuesday.Is over-the-counter trading open on Good Friday?Over-the-counter trading, which is done without an exchange, will be closed on Friday, April 3.United States stock market 2026 holiday scheduleU.S. stock markets are closed on these days in 2026:Monday, Jan. 19: Markets closed for Martin Luther King, Jr. Day.Monday, Feb. 16: Markets closed for Washington's BirthdayFriday, April 3: Markets closed for Good FridayMonday, May 25: Markets closed for Memorial DayFriday, June 19: Markets closed for Juneteenth National Independence DayFriday, July 3: Markets closed for Independence Day (observed)Monday, Sept. 7: Markets closed for Labor DayThursday, Nov. 26: Markets closed for ThanksgivingFriday: Nov. 27: markets close at 1 p.m. ET the Friday after ThanksgivingThursday, Dec. 24: Markets close at 1 p.m. for Christmas EveFriday, Dec. 25: Markets closed for Christmas DayAre international markets open on Good Friday?The London Stock Exchange and EuroNext will be closed on Friday for Good Friday, and on Monday for Easter Monday.The Hong Kong Stock Exchange and Tokyo Stock Exchange will be open normal trading hours on Friday.Is Good Friday a federal holiday?No, neither Good Friday nor Easter are one of the 11 federal holidays.Is Good Friday a Florida state holiday?Florida officially recognizes 20 legal holidays when state offices may be closed. The state also lists doxens separate days, weeks or months that have been designated or proclaimed as a public holiday, with varying suggestions for observance.C. A.
